business_problem: DSO needed sovereign, multilingual large language models it could train and deploy fully on premise for defense workloads, but it lacked at-scale operational experience with the mixture-of-experts architecture it considered essential for next-generation systems.
solution_summary: DSO used Mistral's Forge to accelerate creation of a sovereign multilingual large language model for defense operations. The program started from DSO's existing pretraining work but focused on mastering mixture-of-experts architecture, which the lab viewed as critical for next-generation LLMs. Working in a shared development environment with Mistral, the team trained a specialized MoE model on language data that included content sourced through AI Singapore, then prepared it for entirely on-prem deployment so DSO could avoid external-vendor dependency and supply-chain risk. The engagement was not only about shipping a model: Forge gave DSO repeatable training workflows while close collaboration transferred practical know-how about what works at scale. That left DSO with both a benchmark-competitive multilingual model and stronger in-house capability for later edge reasoning systems.

solution_components.name: Forge
solution_components.role: Provides the end-to-end training system DSO used to co-develop and train its custom multilingual MoE model.

data_flow: Language content sourced via AI Singapore feeds a shared development environment, Forge orchestrates training for the multilingual MoE model, and the resulting model is prepared for entirely on-prem deployment and later edge reasoning work on autonomous systems.
integration_points: autonomous systems operating in the field
business_outcome: The collaboration accelerated DSO's model-development timeline, delivered leading-in-class Southeast Asian language benchmark performance for operational use cases, and strengthened DSO's internal ability to build future edge reasoning models independently.
